articles.title: Bitcoin heads higher as President Trump announces Iran peace agreement
articles.snippet: "An Agreement has been largely negotiated, subject to finalization between the United States of America, the Islamic Republic of Iran, and the various other Countries," wrote President Trump late Saturday afternoon.

articles.title: Trump Media moved but 'did not sell' $205 million in bitcoin amid rising losses on crypto bets
articles.snippet: DJT’s bitcoin strategy remains under pressure as the company sits on hundreds of millions in unrealized crypto losses and widening quarterly deficits.

articles.title: Kevin Warsh sworn in as Fed chair, as traders forecast rate hikes in 2026
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump has repeatedly said he wants the Federal Reserve to lower interest rates, but investors forecast no chance of a rate cut in 2026.

articles.title: Crypto, Banks, Policy Experts Press Congress to Modernize Bank Secrecy Act

articles.title: Trump Media Moves Over $200 Million in Bitcoin as Losses Pile Up: Arkham
